CA.rationale: Content positions and an explicit origin/processing entry are both present for the same candidate referent/time.

COD.rationale: The same candidate referent/time has explicit identified content (red/blue positions), an explicit organization pattern (full-grid positions), and an explicit origin/status entry.

evidence.quote: Current and conditional candidate peaks follow.

A.rationale: Processing/origin metadata (e.g. command_estimate) is attached to candidate content and a statement refers to current vs conditional candidate peaks.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifications (named referents with red/blue coordinate sets) are present.

D.rationale: Content entries are accompanied by separate origin/status metadata, distinguishing identification from record/status information.

O.rationale: Entries describe how content is presented (organized coordinate sets and explicit display orientation), qualifying organization/presentation.
